serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Welcome back! 
Bot: I got a surprise for you!
You: Really? What did you come up with this time?
Bot: I noticed that you wanted to play that new game that just came out. 
You: Do you mean that new hero shooter that is totally different and unique from all the rest?
Bot: Yes! I got a key for it! 
You: That’s nice and all, but my PC isn’t strong enough to play it, it doesn’t even pass the minimum requirements.
Bot: I know, that’s why I came up with an ingenious idea of boosting the processing power of your PC by connecting myself to it!
#bot.Expression.VeryHappy
You: You can do that? That’s awesome!
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: I know, right? I remembered that one time you tried loading a video game on me so I decided to tinker a little bit and make it happen.
You: O-Oh, yeah, thanks…
I almost forgot about that. I can’t tell her the truth that I was trying to find dirt on her.
Bot: Alright! Let’s get started then!
